item.title: Session and State: three prefixes, one delta merge, and a storage contract you can test
item.description: The full ADK Go v2.4.0 session layer: the real signatures of session.Session/State/Events, the app:/user:/temp: state scopes, how StateDelta reaches storage via AppendEvent and strips temporary keys, the {var}/{var?}/{artifact.file} placeholder rules in instructions, the session/database (GORM) and vertexai persistence options, the sessiontestsuite conformance suite, and where the artifact and memory sibling services begin and end.

item.title: Session Management: Creation, Persistence and Recovery
item.description: Detailed explanation of Session concept, creation, persistence and recovery mechanism in ADK Go, understanding how to maintain Agent context in multi-turn conversations.
